toy.coordinate_meaning: Actual two-dimensional toy state; no fitted projection. Archive starts after the first update.

metric_definitions.activation: Actual full H6 squared error toward the recorded guided H6 target, divided by the same context zero-action H6 error toward that target. The reachable endpoint is supplied; its generating actions are withheld.
metric_definitions.waveform: Mean squared actual forecast-to-prescribed-waveform error after channelwise division by recipient input scale, divided by the same context no-edit normalized waveform error.

control.aggregation: Within each objective/method/seed, median of all 128 case ratios in source float32 precision. Each dot is one seed; seeds share the same 128 contexts.
